text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Inari One rests for a few days, the people of her hometown invite her to a festival, hoping for her swift recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Up until now, Inari One has been worried about disappointing her hometown, and it's lead to her fixating on her race results. But her fears disappear after seeing the town's support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She remembers that for a festival to have style, it needs passion. It needs soul.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that soul has to come from her. After all, this is her festival—her fight for the top.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her spirits renewed, Inari One is ready to keep working toward her goal so she can turn the Arima Kinen into the best festival ever!
